comment: What a move becomes when it is Dynamaxed, for the 53 moves the brackets cannot describe.
A Max Move's power is not carried over from the base move and not scaled from it: it is a step
function of it, seven bands wide, with a lower set of steps for Fighting and Poison. Those bands
are BRACKETS in GenerateDataset.kt and cover 386 of the 439 moves that can be Dynamaxed.
These are the other 53, and they fall into three groups:
- multi-hit moves, where the listed power is per hit. Rock Blast is 25 a hit, which the
brackets read as 90; it is really 130, because the conversion counts every hit.
- moves whose power varies with something other than themselves -- Stored Power, Weather Ball,
Electro Ball, Gyro Ball, Rising Voltage, Terrain Pulse, Multi-Attack.
- moves with no listed power at all, which have nothing to look up: Seismic Toss, Night Shade,
Fissure, Super Fang and the rest of the fixed-damage set.
Struggle is its own case at 1.
Source: Bulbapedia's Max Move article, read 2026-09-29. Derived by applying the brackets to all
439 rows of its power table and keeping every row they got wrong, so this list is exactly the
complement of the rule rather than a selection from it. DatasetTest asserts that every move a
Gigantamax form can reach lands in one or the other.
